note: Token counts are the providers own usage fields recorded per call (Groq usage, Gemini usageMetadata). actualChargesUsd.basis: No Anthropic call was made (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY absent, paid budget $0, PAID_DISABLED guard). Groq: free plan, rate-limit headers show the free-plan 8,000 TPM / 1,000 RPD. Gemini: only free-tier-listed models callable. Provider consoles are the billing source of truth.

gemini503: Run 37915380644: Gemini returned HTTP 503 (high demand) on every retry; failed requests are not billed and recorded no usage.
